reason: Initial joint fits from two same-direction tracks had low training error but failed two distinct-direction cars and crossed the observed-road horizon. Those models remain rejected.
scope: Separate development static geometry from clock; prior control cars become explicitly development calibration, never reported as new independent validation.
geometry_method: single linear homography from four candidate stationary vehicle features; no time parameter, no iterative refit
clock_method: closest-point time on frozen projected observed trajectory; retain ambiguity/gaps; test unit-rate offset consistency, no assumed global clock
forbidden: refitting geometry from new validation cars
context_note: Previously viewed scenes are development evidence; different vehicle IDs are control observations, not a separate validation session.
